purpose: App/inbox/retired kind registry with import-time collision check (D12) plus the pure NIP-46 requested-permission builder and stored-session discard predicate (D2).

public_api.name: APP_RUMOR_KINDS
public_api.description: App kinds carried as MLS application rumors.

public_api.name: RESERVED_KINDS
public_api.description: Object.values(RUMOR_KINDS) from the library; no literal copies.

public_api.name: assertNoKindCollisions
public_api.description: Throws naming the kinds on duplicate app kinds, retired collision, or RUMOR_KINDS collision; run at module import.

public_api.name: shouldDiscardStoredNip46Session
public_api.signature: (granted: readonly string[] | string | null | undefined) => boolean
public_api.description: True unless granted perms cover the required set; missing record is discarded.
